name: Engram persistent memory
description: Memory persistence across Claude Code sessions via MCP server

externalTool.name: engram

install.linux:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
arch=$(uname -m | sed -e s/x86_64/amd64/ -e s/aarch64/arm64/)
release=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/Gentleman-Programming/engram/releases/latest)
url=$(printf '%s' "$release" | grep -o "https://[^\"]*linux_${arch}\.tar\.gz" | head -1)
if [ -z "$url" ]; then echo "engram: no se pudo resolver el asset linux_${arch} del release (GitHub API rate-limited o asset ausente). Instala manualmente: https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/engram/releases" >&2; exit 1; fi
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp/engram.tar.gz"
sums=$(printf '%s' "$release" | grep -o "https://[^\"]*checksums\.txt" | head -1)
if [ -n "$sums" ]; then
  expected=$(curl -fsSL "$sums" | grep "linux_${arch}.tar.gz" | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)
  if [ -z "$expected" ]; then echo "engram: checksums.txt no lista el asset linux_${arch} — abortando por seguridad" >&2; exit 1; fi
  actual=$(sha256sum "$tmp/engram.tar.gz" | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then echo "engram: el checksum no coincide (descarga corrupta o alterada) — abortando" >&2; exit 1; fi
else
  echo "engram: el release no publica checksums.txt; se instala sin verificación de integridad" >&2
fi
tar -xzf "$tmp/engram.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" engram
chmod +x "$tmp/engram"
mv -f "$tmp/engram" "$HOME/.local/bin/engram"

externalTool.postInstall: claude plugin marketplace add Gentleman-Programming/engram && claude plugin install engram
